questions.stem: A 52 year old man with history of coronary artery disease is currently on sublingual nitroglycerin 0.5 mg, S0S, metoprolol 50 mg twice a day, aspirin 75 mg once a day, enalapril 5 ma once a day, for the last one year. The patient is now complaining of breathlessness and wheeze. Which one of the following drugs is most likely to be implicated for this new symptom?
